description: This file is a Perl script for generating target configuration and profile makefiles based on target metadata. It includes functions for processing target features, names, versions, and generating configuration blocks for build systems.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration feature strings based on input feature list, mapping feature names to build system options.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a display name for a target, including parent name if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings with dots into underscore-separated format, simplifying version comparison.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Outputs configuration blocks for a target, including features, dependencies, and help text.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two lists of packages, removing duplicates and handling negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate a full target configuration based on parsed target metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile snippets based on target metadata and selected profile.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to invoke appropriate generation functions.
